meta.project: 《星骸回响》Star Echo - AI 美术资产库
meta.purpose: 预制「画风模板 x 要素字典」提示词母版，供云端 GPU 实例批量生成人物/怪物/物品/UI/场景/特效/道具素材
meta.legal: 所有画风模板均为风格转译描述词，不含任何游戏品牌名、角色名、艺术家姓名，符合'风格不受版权保护'的通用法律共识
meta.pipeline: 生成 → 筛选 → tools/img2sprite.py 后处理（抠底→降采样→量化）→ COLOR_DICT.json 调色板校验 → 实装

base.quality: masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed, sharp focus, clean lineart
base.negative: blurry, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, mutated, duplicate, cropped, low quality, worst quality, oversaturated, photorealistic, 3d render
base.negative_pixel: anti-aliasing, soft edges, gradient wash, color bleed, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, mutated, low quality, worst quality

character.extra: full body character concept art, standing pose, clean silhouette
character.note: 先立绘确定形象 → img2sprite 降采样 64px → 精灵

monster.extra: fantasy monster creature, menacing, full body, clear silhouette
monster.note: Boss/精英可走立绘轨；杂兵可像素直出

item.extra: single game item, centered, floating, plain background, game asset
item.note: 武器/道具/材料图标，32px 量级

ui_icon.extra: flat game ui icon, minimal, centered, plain background, crisp edges, single symbol

scene.extra: wide landscape background art, no characters, atmospheric depth, parallax layers

effect.extra: magical effect burst, glowing particles, dynamic energy, no characters
effect.note: 攻击/技能光效，64px 量级，PNG 透明底

prop.extra: game prop, single object, centered, plain background

rules.attribute_order_hint: 一次组合不超过 4 个要素（防串味）；要素优先级：发型 > 服装 > 配色 > 配件

consistency.method: 角色形象固化：img2img 低 denoise(0.3-0.5) + 固定 base_seed + ControlNet(OpenPose) 控姿态
consistency.variant_rule: 变体 seed = base_seed + 序号

verify.mode: 每类要素先抽 5-8 张验证命中率，命中率 < 60% 则改词

portrait.note: 立绘/概念图：画风模板生效层，风格基因最完整，后处理降采样成精灵

pixel_direct.note: 像素直出：需挂 Pixel-Art-XL LoRA + No-AA LoRA，适合 UI/物品/特效等细节要求低类别

no_anti_aliasing.name: no_anti_aliasing
no_anti_aliasing.note: 收紧边缘去渐晕，0.5-0.9 按输出微调

post.downsample: tools/img2sprite.py（floodfill 抠底→bbox→网格降采样→量化）
